title: Intent reader results v1
description: Structural result carriers only. Byte correspondence, source completeness, execution, and authenticity require their owning semantic checks.

wireBytes.$comment: The toWire projection of a native Uint8Array/Buffer. Schema checks canonical base64 syntax; decoded-byte correspondence and caller-specific size bounds require semantic checks.

canonicalHeader.description: Canonical assembled metadata reading data; never an authored header.

diagnostic.$comment: Diagnostic locations preserve unavailable, invalid, or unplaced input. They are not assertions of normalized repository paths.

record.$comment: One exact Markdown source plus identity, selected metadata and reading summary. Structured document views are requested separately.

selectionReason.$comment: A root ID is a preserved request token; an unresolved invalid token is not normalized into an invented Knowledge identity.

interpretation.const: Impact identifies candidates for examination; it does not decide whether prose must change.

checkSpec.$comment: A Check defines verification. Its criteria describe what would satisfy or falsify the proposition; no implementation, executable configuration, or observed result is required.

checkMeaning.$comment: A Check defines verification. Its criteria describe what would satisfy or falsify the proposition; no implementation, executable configuration, or observed result is required.

checkReading.$comment: Readable definition data derived from one workspace observation. Criteria and verified-by relationships are not outcomes. Current source/target resolution, full body correspondence, serialized byte bounds and contextual completeness require semantic checks.
